# Helvety Auth

> Centralized authentication service used by the Helvety ecosystem. Engineered and designed in Switzerland.

## Canonical URL
- [Sign In](https://helvety.com/auth/login): Primary sign-in page

## Crawling And Indexing
- Auth routes are intended not to be indexed.
- These routes are not intended as crawl targets and are protected by noindex metadata and authentication controls.

## Related Helvety Apps
- [Helvety](https://helvety.com)
- [Helvety Store](https://helvety.com/store)
- [Helvety PDF](https://helvety.com/pdf)
- [Helvety Contacts](https://helvety.com/contacts)
- [Helvety Notes](https://helvety.com/notes)
- [Helvety Tasks](https://helvety.com/tasks)
